reviews.text: What a gem of a dog spa! I wasn’t sure what kind of cut would be best for my 7-month-old Bernedoodle, so I took a leap of faith with Old Mill Dog Spa, and I couldn’t be happier that I did! Their service, talent, and attention to detail are amazing.I also love the report they provide after his appointment…such a thoughtful touch that shows how much they care. We’ll definitely be back, and I highly recommend to anyone looking for a talented and caring groomer for their fur baby!

I cannot explain how much we (which includes our puppy, Barbara) love the Old Mill Dog Spa. They handle her with such love and care, and she comes home looking perfect. Our puppy is also an 80 pound baby, so  this is a big shout out to the team for their service and patience. They also provide curated report cards so we can see how the groom went.

We can’t wait to see Barbara grow with you!

Natasha is so kind and gentle and we instantly felt good about leaving our little guy for his first grooming session. She did an amazing job and our guy was so happy. We especially loved receiving the report card and hearing details of his experience and seeing the pictures. Above and beyond service!

Gave my dog an excellent bath, left him with no shedding and smelling great. Staff there are exceptionally nice and helpful and the pricing is transparent and reasonable . Overall I would reccomend this place for any sort of dog grooming and they do nails too !
Always a fabulous experience at the Spa! Thanks for making our pup beautiful…and less shedding;)

We’ve been bringing our pup to Natasha and the team for about 2 years now and they are fantastic! Murphy is a bit scared of the process but they treat him with such care and positivity. We also love that the grooming facilities are visible from the front desk!  In fact, we ended up moving away from the neighbourhood but still make the drive and continue to bring Murphy to Old Mill Dog Spa.

Have tried several dog groomers in the area, but this is by far the best. Super clean facility, very friendly and helpful staff and their work in consistently amazing. I recently joined their monthly membership program - even better prices. Love this spot and love seeing my “new” dogs after each visit. Highly recommend.

As many other customers have testified, this place is the real deal. We went to Old Mill Dog Spa to help us restore our Golden Retriever pup’s beauty after highly unfortunate topcoat issues elsewhere.

Our pup, who is normally visibly anxious and scared by grooming dryers and tools shocked me by instantly bonding with Natasha and happily exploring the facility with her. It was extremely clear that Natasha not only understood different dog breed requirements, but was passionate about celebrating each dog as an individual. This was the first time I had a groomer explain clearly what she was going to do and I left feeling my girl was in great hands.

When I returned my pup didn’t even notice me as she was happily prancing around and being loved-on by the staff. What a change from the dog who used to be sitting anxiously waiting for me. She was truly content.

They also showed me videos of her during the groom smiling calmly during her blow dry (I was shocked) and beaming while sitting in the tub. She came back properly groomed with her topcoat fully in tact and her undercoat having had the old fluff *properly* removed. She went above and beyond to blend the old issues (obvious cut marks) and my girl looked beautiful. Now we are on the right track to her beautiful natural coat growing out as best it can.

We received a wonderful, descriptive ‘report card’ that detailed what was done at the appointment and how she handled each step - no anxiety this time! She even took the time out of her evening to send me an email with her recommendations and links for products that would help us restore and repair her coat from the previous damage.

We have definitely found our new groomer and it is such a relief to have my dog in good hands this time and going forward.

THANK YOU!
I’m super happy with how my Golden Retriever was groomed! He looks amazing and came home so clean, fluffy, and handsome. You can really tell they care about what they do. Highly recommend!

I had a very disappointing experience at this pet salon. The way I was treated and spoken to was extremely disrespectful and unprofessional. I felt that I was treated differently because of my background, and the comments and attitude I experienced were completely inappropriate.

We love the old mill dog spa they always take such good care of my dog and always check in with me throughout the process. He leaves looking so great!  They are also super friendly and lovely to deal with!

Amazing first grooming experience for Kaia! It was the first time taking my one year old Doberman grooming. The staff explained their process to me beforehand and assured me that they will take good care of Kaia (and they did). Knowing my dog’s breed and how big she is, that’s not an easy feat so for her to come out of the grooming positively (smelling wonderful) really gives me confidence that the groomers took their time with her and took good care of her. I loved the report card after the fact and Kaia even received a free nail trimming for her first visit! We will be back!
I had the most amazing experience, would definitely recommend this place to anyone. The customer service was amazing from Zach at the front desk to the groomer
Love this place it’s so awesome. Super friendly and thank you to Zach for all his help!

A great experience from start to finish, Zach was so kind and customer service was next level (so hard to find great customer service these days.)
Natasha did exactly what we asked for and our dog was so happy coming in and out of the spa.  Products used are also high quality.  Will be back for sure

I came by last week with my dog and I cant say enough good things about this dog spa! Everything about the experience was incredible! Zach at the front desk was very helpful, kind and informative. The groomers were also amazing! I most definitely will be back and if you’re in the Old Mill area looking for a new trustworthy place to bring your pet, this is the place to go! 10/10
Groomer did a fantastic job— the lost star is due to the front desk employee. Would overall still recommend.
Thank you so much for your kind review. We genuinely appreciate it!

Great experience! My dog is not a fan of  being groomed but that changed with Natasha. Natasha truly has a gift with dogs and a talent for making them look so adorable!  Thank you for making grooming enjoyable for my dog.
Highly recommend old mill dog spa!

Class act  !!! Always happy with the grooming
Natasha is awesome 👏!!!! …

I had a great experience at old mill dog spa! They did an excellent haircut for my dog, and I was very happy with the results. The staff were friendly, professional, and took the time to answer all of my questions. They made both me and my dog feel comfortable throughout the visit. I will definitely be visiting again and highly recommend their services to other pet owners!
Thank you for your kind review. We are always so grateful and happy to see you and your fur baby!

Old Mill Dog Spa went above and beyond my expectations when taking care of my fluffy friend. They have all the care, needs and tools to make sure your fluffy friend is up to tip top shape. The greatest service in the GTA.
Thank you for your kind review and patronage Francoise! We adore your fur baby!

My 17 year old Teacup
Poodle was groomed today.  He is blind and deaf and a bit of a spoiled needy lad - his grooming was done quickly and absolutely perfect.  I am beyond satisfied🦋 …

I enjoy taking my dog to the Old Mill Dog Spa. All staff members are very welcoming and always kind.
My dog is double-coated and always gets groomed by Natasha. Natasha takes care of my dog so well and she always comes back with a clean cut.

I wish I had known about this dog spa much earlier. Highly recommend.

I visited the Old Mil Dog SPA. today. Luckily I was able to have my puppy
Groomed on time. Staff were very caring professional.
. Reasonable pricing . My dog is very happy. She is soft thank you so much for your service will definitely be coming in again.🙏🏻 …

I can’t say enough good things about The Old Mill Dog Spa. From the second I walk in, the environment is friendly and welcoming. Scottie loves to be there and is PawFect 💕when I pick her up. Love it there! Natasha is the absolute best groomer around! Xoxo …

We were first timers at Old Mill Dog Spa today. What a great experience, our Labradoodle Roxy isn’t usually very good with groomers. We had Natasha today and she was awesome, Roxy looks great. Couldn’t have been a better experience for us, would recommend highly Old Mill Dog Spa.

Thought I liked this place, seemed nice, did a good job etc..but on a recent visit the owner was running behind from other dogs and when it came our appointment was snippy in tone and not particularly pleasant any longer. I understand days can be long and your dealing with dogs all day, but being spoken to like I’m an inconvenience does jot make me want to return.

I just completed my first visit with my fur baby, an 8 pound toy poodle.  I could not be happier.  I had a tough time when we moved to Etobicoke trying to find someone I can trust.  I took a chance on Old Mill Dog Spa and I was very impressed.  My other fur baby has an appointment in a few days and I know that they will do a wonderful job on her.
Amazing high quality and care grooming for my Yorkie. Natasha and team are wonderful.

We have been taking our three small dogs here for two or so years now. Natasha has shown love, care, and attention to all three.

The facility is warm, inviting, and professional.

Personal touch is such an important factor in this line of work and Natasha excels in spades. It is abundantly clear that dog grooming is more than just a job to her - it is her craft.

We have been to other grooming facilities across the GTA and none have given us the same satisfaction as Old Mill Dog Spa. We have always left happy and I’d argue that’s the most important factor to consider when leaving your dogs in the care of someone else.
Friendly staff, great service, pleasant atmosphere
Thank you!
Highly recommend taking your dog here! Natasha spent so much extra time making sure our doodle was well taken care of. Thank you and Zack!
Very personal expert care. My five-year old toy poodle has had 3 previous groomers, all good, but the Old Mill Dog Spa was noticeably the best.

Came to use the self serve dog washing. The room is very clean, machine is easy to use, staff was very nice. The towels provided were smelly, so opted not to use them. We have a medium sized dog, so it would be nice if there was an option to pay less, for less time. 30 minutes is not needed for the size of our dog, we were finished with 10 minutes still remaining.

I had to write a review for Old Mill Dog Spa after the fantastic experience Pika and I had. First off, the cut is absolutely amazing! Pika has been getting non-stop compliments everywhere we go – everyone wants to know where he got his perfect trim.

What really stood out to me was Pika's mood after his appointment. Sometimes, grooming can be a stressful experience for him, but this time he came back practically bouncing with joy. He genuinely seemed re-energized and has had a smile on his face ever since. It's clear they create a positive and caring environment for the dogs.

The location is another huge plus. Being right on the subway line makes it incredibly convenient, and I had no trouble finding parking nearby. While Pika was getting pampered, I had a wonderful time exploring the beautiful neighbourhood, enjoying the nature and the lovely shops close by. It turned a regular grooming appointment into a pleasant afternoon for both of us.

I would wholeheartedly recommend Old Mill Dog Spa to anyone looking for a top-quality grooming experience for their pup. We will definitely be back!

I have an afghanhound, who is a show dog and I'm particular where I take him I was very impressed with the shop, it looked like a high-end spa, very clean. Natasha looked after him from start to finish, great job, I would recommend this place to anyone. I will be back.

Absolutely wonderful experience ! This was my first visit with Ruby and Natasha was so professional . She advised me against going with a specific type of cut for my doodle and explaining to me the difference between her suggestion and mine ! I’m so glad I listened to her .

She took her time working on Ruby and she did such a good job, I would definitely recommend her to all the doodle parents in the area
Absolutely great grooming … Purdis had a very caring experience  , tailored to her incredible 17 years (and going strong). Natasha made us feel that every dog matters. We will confidently go back!
Old Mill Dog Spa does a wonderful job bathing and grooming Henry, our handsome Bearded Collie. It’s easy to make reservations and we greatly appreciate the up-front pricing of services.

Natasha does a great job with our mini golden doodle and our sheepadoodle.
Bentley and Daisy are not afraid to go into the spa. Natasha treats them with kindness and care. Our dogs come out looking great.

Was our first visit and won’t be our last. Organized, Spacious and clean.   Our Shiba Inu’s coat never looked so beautiful or smelt so lovely.  Natasha was great with Suki.
Watched the DIY bath stations - outstanding!!
First visit and I was so impressed ! They did a great job with both my dogs and we will be back

I recently took my pup to Natasha’s dog spa, and I’m thrilled with their grooming techniques! The staff expertly hand-brushed my dog’s coat to detangle it gently, followed by precision scissoring for a polished look, especially around his ears and tail. Their de-shedding treatment used specialized tools to remove loose fur, leaving his coat smooth and shiny. Nail grinding was gentle yet effective, and they used a soothing ear-cleaning solution and hydrating shampoo tailored to his sensitive skin. The process was calm, and my pup came out looking and smelling amazing. Highly recommend this spa for top-notch, personalized grooming!
Thank you so much Claudiu! See you again soon.

I recently moved to the area and was worried about finding a reliable dog spa. A friend recommended this spa, and from the moment we walked in, Natasha and her team made us feel so welcome. Baxter enjoyed a blueberry facial and aromatherapy rinse that left his coat unbelievably soft and shiny, and the puppy play lounge became his new favourite spot. It’s miles better than our previous groomer—I can’t recommend Natasha and her team highly enough!

The team at Old Mill Dog Spa consistently provides the most outstanding care for our beloved Shih Tzu.  At 14 years of age, he requires a great deal of love and attention, and I am always grateful for the team's dedication to his well-being. The team shows genuine care for him, and he comes out looking extra cute and fluffy after his visits.  Thank you for your exceptional service. We always have a complete peace of mind knowing that our pup is in such capable hands. Ps. we love the report cards!
Very disappointed with the quality & service here. Extremely expensive too - Dogtopia across the street is great

I’m so glad we found Old Mill Dog Spa! My dog, Ellie, used to be terrified of grooming after some bad experiences at other places. She would always come home stressed after her haircuts. But since we started taking her to Old Mill Dog Spa, her tail is always up, and she seems so much happier. Natasha is incredibly gentle and patient with Ellie. Last time, Ellie’s fur was severely matted, and we thought shaving was the only option—but Natasha worked her magic, and Ellie looked adorable afterward!

I want to thank the staff at Old Mill Dog Spa for doing such a wonderful job on my puppy.  I’ve tried other groomers but I have to say they are one of the best.  They were patient, kind and professional and my fur baby looks great!

The groomers were very kind and patient with my elderly dog. They did an excellent job. It was expensive but he was in pretty bad shape (grooming wise) so it was worth it.  I will go back and I would recommend Old Mill Dog Spa.

Took my 7 month old morkie for his second groom ever to Old mill dog spa and had a great experience with Natasha. She took the time to speak prior to his appointment about how we wanted him groomed. You can tell this place really cares about animals. Also love that you can see the whole operation from the front door. Very clean spot!! Highly recommend and will be back.

The experience at Old Mill Dog Spa was truly amazing! They elevated dog grooming to a whole new level. The time and care they took with my sensitive senior dog was outstanding and he looked perfect! The spa itself was so clean with a relaxing atmosphere. Exactly like a spa should be. I highly recommend Old Mill Dog Spa! Plus the report card they send at the end of the service is adorable. Check them out!

We took our Cavapoo for his first visit and were really impressed with their professionalism.  It's a quieter environment for our anxious little guy which was perfect. I really appreciated that they took note of specific features to make him look like his best self.  Will be going back.

My dog Skye loves this place! Natasha and the staff are great with her and she always comes home looking and smelling great. They always make her feel comfortable before they get started. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a quality spa day for their dog.
Thank you for your kind review and business, we appreciate it!
Thank you!

I had such a great experience getting my dog's nails cut. I left her for 15 minutes, and when I came back she looked so happy, with her nails looking amazing. So glad to have found this place— we’ll be back!

The dog washing station is so convenient, my dog hates baths but he let me wash him there. Excellent experience.. I highly recommend it.
Also my dog won't let me or even the vet cut his nails but they were able to cut his nails in just a few minutes AND he came out a happy  dog...AMAZING!
Love this place!

What a great place!  The self serve wash has such a high pressure water stream with built in shampoo and conditioner! It cut bathing time in half! I went to also learn tips of how to properly bath and dry and comb in an effective and efficient way.  Invaluable learnings since I bathe my dogs at home weekly.   Lucky to have this place open so close to high park, and with very experienced and talented groomers!  Thanks so much! Looking forward to coming back

Just took my little yorkie mix here. She is a rescue dog and generally is very stressed by grooming. She was nervous when we brought her in but totally relaxed during the groom! I never seen her so calm at the end. And she looked fantastic!

My dog only ever goes to groomers to get her nails clipped but it's always been a struggle to find someone that does a good job and treats her well.

My dog (Mya) can come across as aggressive when she's scared. Many groomers don't put in the effort to relax her and resort to rough methods which just makes things worse. To top it off, they usually end up doing a bad job or hurt her. Once she came home with bruises. My vet even wanted to use a mild sedative before agreeing to cut her nails. The way some of these people act, you would think my dog is a huge monster but she's only 12 lbs and will do just about anything for a treat.

There was only one man that could handle her with care and do a decent job but he is too far from our new place. I'm so glad Old Mill Dog Spa opened up when it did because my poor dog's nails were in terrible shape. They were able to get her nails back under control in just a few sessions.

My dog always comes home smelling great with a little cute bandana and in good spirits. I love the report cards they send too. Such a nice touch.

The owner and her staff are good people. If you want your dog to be treated with kindness, this is the groomer for you. Fair prices, excellent service, convenient location and more. Can you tell I love these guys? 🥰

My wife brings our 4-month old puppy in for a grooming appointment and warns them explicity, 'He's a nervous puppy and gets very anxious. Please talk to him in a calm voice and don't give him any treats.' Within 30 seconds they're talking to him in a baby-voice and feeding him treats. Sigh!
Later that night, they send us a scathing 'report card' detailing how awful, unpleasant, and anxious our dog is, and how he sometimes bites and needs training. Um, no kidding? He's a PUPPY!
And we warned them he was an anxious dog, they either weren't listening or they forgot. Attached to that email was a video file showing the groomer lady getting visibly frustrated and annoyed at our dog. Maybe this isn't the right line of work for you, ma'am.

When we responded to the email saying that we WARNED them about our dog's anxiety, they sent us a long rant explaining what bad dog owners we are and how we don't know how to train a puppy. At this point, our poor boy had only seen a trainer twice, but these people apparently don't have the patience to deal with a dog that wasn't trained by Ceasar Milan.

To make things even worse, they never even bothered to trim our dog's ears, face, or neck. They made him look like a bobblehead, so that night we had to trim his face and neck ourselves. We basically didn't receive the service that we paid for (a rip-off overall).
And guess what? When my wife and I trimmed his head, he was totally calm and unbothered! I think if the Old Mill Dog Spa staff try this calm and patient approach, they'll have better luck handling puppies in the future.

In conclusion, don't take your dog here if it's less than 10 months old. They have NO CLUE how to handle puppies, and they won't hesitate to tell you how annoyed they are with your sweet little dog.

I had an amazing experience at old mill dog spa with my Biewer Terrier, Chloe! From the moment we walked in, Natasha was welcoming and attentive, making Chloe feel comfortable and relaxed. She took the time to understand exactly how I wanted her groomed, and the results were flawless.

Chloe looked absolutely adorable with her fresh cut, and her coat was soft and shiny. I could tell they used high-quality products and paid attention to every detail. What stood out most was how gentle and caring the groomers were with her – she can be a little shy, but she came out happy and wagging her tail!

I also appreciated how clean and well-organized the salon was. The appointment ran on time, and the service was efficient without feeling rushed. I highly recommend old mill dog spa to anyone looking for a professional and caring grooming experience. Chloe and I will definitely be back!
Thank you! It was such a pleasure meeting Tily today! See you soon :)

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We take every review seriously, but we also believe reviews should be based on genuine experiences.

After reviewing our records, we have no record of you visiting, purchasing from, or receiving service from our business. Because of that, we’re unable to understand what experience your review is based on.

We welcome honest criticism from actual customers and are always willing to address legitimate concerns directly. However, posting claims about a business without having experienced our service firsthand is unfair to our team and misleading to potential customers.

If you did in fact visit our business, please contact us directly with the date and details of your visit so we can investigate and make things right. Otherwise, we respectfully ask that you reconsider leaving a review based on an experience that did not occur.

horrible place, brought a pretty dog for a trim that shouldn’t be noticeable, came back to pick up the dog he’s left with no fur.  Owner of the place started yelling at us and kicking us out, after our question what they did to the dog, we have been called nightmare clients and she also was calling that a child. Afterwards, saw a post on their story of our pet without them asking if he can be posted as an advertisement. Therefore we texted them. politely on instagram what is the consent of picture taking in Ontario, since she Is the owner she must know, got a really mean reply and was threatened that she is warning us one last time ( it was a simple question ). HORRIBLE. If you love your pets don't give them to this business. The child is really upset and feels really upset after she has been called a nightmare by a person she doesn't know after we asked a question. Oh and to mention the pets paws were covered in something yellow and when we asked what it is maybe something happened a cut or something, we never got an answer back, now all we hope is that our pet doesn't get an allergy from that since we didn't get an answer what it is!  Paying was not a problem when we tried paying we got kicked out and the doors were locked! Love your pets and care about them. HIGHLY DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!!!!!!!!
(The response you are seeing under my review is the complete opposite of reality and what we have been told in the spa and on intagram)

I recently took my dog to this groomer & am absolutely thrilled with the experience.  From the moment I made the appointment, I felt the staff's warm and welcoming attitude.  They took the time to listen to my specific requests, ask questions about my dog's personality and understand her grooming needs.  Natasha is very knowledgeable, friendly and thorough.  I highly recommend them and wish them the best.

We are a repeat customer! We have taken our 1-year-old pup to Old Mill Dog Spa since it opened for a full groom and bath. Like most pups, he doesn't love the bath but the Old Mill Dog Spa team does a great job making sure he is comfortable. They provide excellent service and listen to what you're looking for from the groom/bath. Our pup looks and smells great every time we've picked him up.
The Old Mill Dog Spa made my Yorkie Baxter even more handsome. 🙏🏼 Natasha and Team …

My small puppy has been twice for a bath and groom, and I've been pleased with the results. I have paid less for a grooming but was not nearly as happy as the service we got at Old Mill Dog Spa. The skill and attention to detail is obviously there. He comes back soft and smelling great.

Nice environment and most importantly, Natasha is so skilled! The report card is a great added touch. Charlie came home "so fresh and so clean"
Also the location is quite nice where there are plenty of cafes I can hang around and wait for the groom to be done.
Natasha comes highly recommended, especially if you own a Bulldog.
Will definitely be going back ☺️
Koko had a wonderful afternoon at Old Mill Dog Spa. Natasha gave us a tour first so that everyone was comfortable. Her place is very clean and the self serve very practical. Great experience.
Thank you Vanessa! We genuinely appreciate your kindness.
We took our two dogs in and the service was awesome. They asked all the right questions and really cared for our dogs. We will return!

We love bringing our two dogs here! Puff and Fin always leave looking so good and so happy. Natasha and her team are wonderful and their love of animals and knowledge of grooming is so apparent. The dogs are always so excited to get groomed and we feel good knowing they’re in such capable hands. Highly recommend!
